item_summary: $80-120 high-resolution 4K webcam with AI auto-framing, low-light correction, and dual noise-canceling microphones
detailed_item_draft: Procurement Requirement: Professional 4K Webcam. Budget Cap: $80-$120 USD. Resolution: Native 4K (3840x2160) at 30fps minimum with HDR support. Smart Features: AI auto-framing for subject tracking and centering; advanced low-light correction for dim environments. Audio: Dual-array noise-canceling microphones for background suppression and voice isolation. Connectivity: Plug-and-play USB 3.0/2.0 (Type-A or Type-C). Field of View: Adjustable (78-120 degrees). Mounting: Universal monitor clip with 1/4-inch tripod thread. OS Compatibility: Windows, macOS, ChromeOS. Preferred Extras: Privacy shutter, autofocus, automatic white balance.
